Aristotle.summary: Recommended strict rule: all required codes present, unexpected extras fail, dominant equals expected primary, and no connector/cloud/cleanup/GMUT movement.

Cicero.summary: Recommended fields for missing required codes, unexpected codes, dominant reason, assertion status, fail-closed flag, mutation scope, and GMUT gate effect.

Kierkegaard.summary: Set claim boundaries: allowed-extra policy improves local reviewability but does not prove safety, correctness, publication readiness, connector authority, cleanup approval, or GMUT validation.
